source: multi30k: searched 3 rates (0.5x, 1x, 2x the published one) on `baseline` alone. the published rate reaches the published range (40.46), so it stands. Confirmed, not replaced. Every architecture in the grid is trained on this recipe unchanged; none of them had a vote in it. Published starting point: Wu et al. 2021 (arXiv 2105.14462): transformer_tiny, dropout 0.3, joint BPE, inverse-sqrt from 5e-3 with 2,000 warmup steps. Their batch is set in tokens and ours in sentences, so the step count is approximate and `ana tune` confirms the rate against development loss.
